blocks.text: Columbus's Most Trusted James Hardie Siding Contractors
James Hardie Siding in Columbus, OH
Professional James Hardie Siding Services in Columbus, Ohio

Your home deserves more than just any exterior covering. Whether you're updating worn-out vinyl, upgrading from wood siding, or installing completely new fiber cement siding on your existing home, the quality of that installation determines everything. How long your siding lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional James Hardie installation done right protects your family for decades. One careless installation creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to upgrade to James Hardie, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which HardiePlank profile works best for your architecture? How do ColorPlus finishes compare to primed options? What underlayment provides real moisture protection? Should you upgrade your house wrap? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between siding that performs beautifully for 30 years and material that fails in year ten.
Why Columbus Homeowners Choose James Hardie Siding

Here's what separates professional James Hardie installation from amateur work. The materials are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which products you choose. We've replaced countless siding installations that used premium fiber cement but failed early because someone rushed the job, skipped critical steps, or didn't understand proper flashing techniques.

Central Ohio's weather demands more from your siding than most people realize. Spring storms test every plank's impact resistance. Summer heat and humidity cycle moisture through your walls thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every nail's holding power. Winter freeze-thaw cycles push water into gaps where poor installation leaves vulnerabilities. Your James Hardie needs to handle all of this, year after year, without compromise.

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to install your new James Hardie siding last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Small gaps appearing at corners where improper expansion spacing shows. Paint peeling where moisture gets trapped behind improperly flashed trim. Planks cracking where installers face-nailed instead of blind-nailing. Your beautiful new siding is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.

Poor installation doesn't announce itself on day one. It reveals itself slowly through premature failure, costly repairs , and frustration. By the time you realize something's wrong, warranty claims get denied because "improper installation voids coverage." You're stuck paying twice for the same siding.
Columbus's Most Trusted James Hardie Services

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years installing James Hardie siding that performs exactly as it should. We specialize in professional fiber cement installation that solves problems before they start. We're not here to rush through your project. We're here to give you properly installed siding with quality materials, experienced crews, and guarantees that mean something.
Expert James Hardie Installation for Every Situation

Many Columbus homeowners come to us with different installation needs. Maybe you're replacing deteriorating vinyl siding that's faded and cracked. Maybe you're building a new home and want fiber cement durability from day one. Maybe you're adding an addition and need seamless integration with your existing exterior. Maybe your current siding has moisture damage and needs complete tear-off.
Whatever brings you here, you probably have questions. What's the best approach for your situation? How long will installation take? What can you expect during the process?

Here's exactly what happens. Call us for a free consultation and we'll come to your property within 24 hours. We'll discuss your goals, explain your options, and provide a detailed written estimate. We've installed James Hardie on hundreds of Columbus homes, and we know what it takes to deliver results you can count on for decades.
Need more than just siding? Protect your entire home with professional roofing services that complement your new exterior beautifully!
Our Proven Columbus James Hardie Process
Frequently Asked Questions About James Hardie Siding in Columbus
How much does James Hardie siding cost in Columbus?

Most Columbus James Hardie installations range from $15,000 to $35,000, depending on home size, architectural complexity, and product choice. A typical 2,000 square foot home with HardiePlank lap siding averages $20,000-$28,000. Additions typically cost $8,000-$15,000. We provide detailed estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until installation is 100% complete.
How long does James Hardie installation take in Columbus?

Most residential James Hardie installations take 5-10 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in 5-7 days, while complex two-story homes typically take 8-10 days. New construction timelines coordinate with your builder's schedule. Weather can affect the timeline.
What James Hardie products do you recommend for Columbus homes?

HardiePlank lap siding is most popular for Columbus homes, offering excellent durability with a 30-year warranty. HardieShingle provides authentic cedar shake appearance without maintenance. ColorPlus Technology delivers factory-applied color that resists fading for 15 years. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which products work best for your home.
Do you handle James Hardie installation for new construction projects?

Yes, we work with homeowners, builders, and contractors on new construction James Hardie installation throughout Columbus. We coordinate with your construction timeline, deliver materials on schedule, and install according to code requirements and manufacturer specifications.
Can you install James Hardie over my existing siding?

Building code allows overlay installation in some situations, but we rarely recommend it. Complete tear-off lets us inspect your sheathing, replace damaged materials, ensure proper moisture barriers, and install new house wrap. This approach delivers better long-term performance and allows full manufacturer warranties.
What makes Coldstream Exteriors different from other Columbus siding companies?

You pay nothing until your James Hardie installation is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We're James Hardie Elite Preferred Contractors with the highest manufacturer certification. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating Columbus homeowners right for 25 years.
How do I prepare my home for James Hardie installation?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, trim back shrubs within 3 feet of the house, remove wall decorations that might fall from vibration, and plan for some noise during installation. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.
